subject: SyncroCity workshop week — slot confirmation & localization needs
messages:
From: Alex Torres <alex.torres@syncrocity.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-01 15:02 PDT
Subject: SyncroCity workshop week — slot confirmation & localization needs

Hi Soojin,

Thanks again for running through options last week. We're locking down our executive workshop for the week of June 21 and want to confirm Redwood's availability and some localization requirements before we send calendar blocks to the broader attendee list. High-level: 2 x half-day workshops (customer execs + product stakeholders) and 1 x technical deep-dive for engineering.

Can you confirm:
- Preferred day/time windows (we're in PT for HQ, but have a small EU engineering team that may dial in)
- Onsite headcount expectation (we'll have 12 on-site, 6 remote)
- Any Redwood AV/vendor needs if you come onsite (projector, mics, whiteboards)
- Whether you can ship a demo kit early (we have a dedicated loading dock)

Also, quick note on localization: several of our slide decks reference region-specific compliance controls. Can someone from Redwood review a short appendix before the workshop? If possible, please have it done by June 14.

If you want, propose two slot options and we'll pick.

Appreciate it — looking forward to getting dates on the calendar.

—Alex
Principal, Partnerships
SyncroCity

[Attachment: SyncroCity-draft-agenda-v0.9.pdf (PDF)]

From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
To: Alex Torres <alex.torres@syncrocity.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-02 09:18 PDT
Subject: Re: SyncroCity workshop week — slot confirmation & localization needs

Alex — thanks, this is helpful. We're excited to run this with you. Proposed slots (Redwood team availability):

Option A:
- Tue June 22: half-day exec workshop (09:00–12:30 PT) 
- Wed June 23: technical deep-dive (13:00–17:00 PT)

Option B:
- Wed June 23: half-day exec workshop (10:00–13:30 PT)
- Thu June 24: technical deep-dive (09:00–13:00 PT)

Notes and asks from our side:
- Onsite headcount: please confirm final in-person attendees by June 7 so we can assign room layout and catering.
- Demo kit shipping: we can receive and stage a small kit (~2 boxes). Please provide carrier ETA and tracking and label to Redwood / c/o SyncroCity floor manager.
- AV: we'll bring our standard presentation kit (HD laptop, backup dongles, speaker lapel mic + room mic if >20 attendees). If you need projector or stage audio, let Marissa know — she is looping in our AV partner.
- Localization/compliance appendix: Connor, can you take the review? We'd aim to return a short annotative pass by June 11 to give Alex and team time to incorporate changes.

If either option works for you, we can convert to calendar holds and share a small timezone matrix for EU dial-in.

Thanks — I'll hold both options tentatively and will wait for headcount confirmation.

Best,
Soojin
Head of Customer GTM
Redwood Inference

[Attachment: SyncroCity-draft-agenda-v0.9.pdf (re-attached)]

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-02 11:06 PDT
Subject: Re: SyncroCity workshop week — slot confirmation & localization needs

Looping in operational details for clarity. Key ops notes: 

- Travel & arrival windows: recommend Redwood team fly in the day before final exec workshop start; this reduces rehearsal risk. For Option A we'd arrive Monday evening (June 21). For Option B we'd arrive Tuesday evening (June 22).
- Hotel: we'll book one standard room per on-site presenter; Marissa will share hotel block link once Alex confirms preferred hotel (we can coordinate reimbursement policy if needed).
- AV vendor: Connor and I recommend using Bolt AV (local partner). They handle projector, lapel/room mics, live-recording option. If SyncroCity wants vendor on-site, please confirm in advance.
- Demo kit logistics: shipping label should read: "Redwood Inference — Attn: Marissa Cole — SyncroCity HQ — Loading Dock". Please include preferred delivery date (we can accept two days prior). We'll store in staging room.
- Security/badging: SyncroCity, will your building require visitor badges or pre-registration? If so, we need a list of names and IDs 72 hours before.
- Accessibility/timezones: I'll prepare a short timezone overlap table (PT/ET/BST) for calendar invites and include dial-in window recommendations for EU attendees (we prefer 08:00–11:00 PT to include late-afternoon BST).

I'll attach a light on-site runbook template — fill in the red fields and return to me by Jun 7.

Marissa
Director, Field Ops
Redwood Inference

[Attachment: onsite-runbook.xlsx (Excel) — please fill red fields]

From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
To: Alex Torres <alex.torres@syncrocity.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-03 09:14 PDT
Subject: Confirmed: Tue/Wed options + next steps (SyncroCity workshop)

Alex — thanks for the quick turnaround. SyncroCity preference? If you confirm Option A (Tue 6/22 exec / Wed 6/23 deep-dive) we will: 

- Create calendar holds today for both options and mark Option A as preferred pending headcount (we'll release Option B on Jun 8 if no changes)
- Marissa will send hotel block link and AV partner contact by EOD tomorrow
- Connor will take the compliance appendix review and return annotated notes by Jun 11
- Please send the visitor list + any badge pre-registrations 72 hours before arrival (we can accept via form or spreadsheet)
- For demo kit shipping: please plan for delivery by Mon 6/20 with tracking to the loading dock; label as Marissa requested.

Action items (next 10 days):
1) Alex: confirm preferred option + provide final on-site headcount by Jun 7.
2) Alex: confirm whether Bolt AV will be used or if SyncroCity will provide room AV (reply inline).
3) Connor: start compliance appendix review, target notes by Jun 11.
4) Marissa: share runway/runbook and hotel block link (EOD tomorrow).

If Option A works, we'll send the calendar invites with timezone-friendly dial-in windows for the EU attendees (we'll include a short note in invites so EU guests see local times).

Thanks — excited to run this with you.

Best,
Soojin
Head of Customer GTM
Redwood Inference
